itens.t: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Impeached and Placed Under House Arrest
itens.r: In less than 48 hours, Paraguayan President Santiago Peña faced a rapid impeachment by Congress and was subsequently placed under house arrest. The dramatic political crisis was triggered by massive public fallout following state intervention in a popular digital bank.
itens.d:
Paraguay's President Santiago Peña was ousted from office and placed under house arrest following a severe political crisis triggered by an intervention in Ueno Bank. The measure left approximately 3 million clients without access to their funds, prompting an arrest warrant and subsequent Senate impeachment.

Peña was detained by Paraguayan police officers in Asuncion. Prosecutors are currently reviewing evidence regarding potential crimes including abuse of authority and influence trafficking, while the former president awaits further legal proceedings.

itens.t: James Webb Space Telescope Unveils Giant Exoplanet With Coronagraphy
itens.r: Astronomers utilized the James Webb Space Telescope to block out starlight and successfully image a massive, elusive exoplanet hidden in deep space darkness.
itens.d:
Astronomers utilizing observations from the James Webb Space Telescope have revealed a giant exoplanet designated 51 Eridani b. The gas giant shares a mass equivalent to roughly 11 Jupiters and orbits a host star located approximately 97 light-years away.

Although ground-based telescopes discovered the planet in 2015, starlight initially obscured it from JWST observations. Researchers successfully used a computer program to remove the stellar glare and expose the distant world.

itens.t: Mars Toxic Dust Can Penetrate Spacesuits and Reach Human Brains

itens.d:

The microscopic dust particles are fine enough to infiltrate deep into human lungs after entering through the nose.

Researchers analyzed the material using the rover's PIXL instrument on fabric samples from spacesuits. Findings revealed that the dust is rich in iron, sulfur, and phosphorus, making it hazardous due to its ability to bypass normal vascular filtration systems.
